milestones.title: The operator guide says how your organization's security officer sets thresholds, the system-high, markings, code words and guide rules
Your organization signs a classification@1 section before automatic raises are used at Protected A or above

remediation: Nothing ships as values (70.1 D-07): a level with no threshold has no automatic model raise, a section with no systemHigh gives no possible-spill outcome, and no marking pattern, code word or guide rule is built in. Your organization's security officer sets the cost ratios and recall targets per level, the system-high of each deployment layer, the English and French banner and portion markings, the code-word list (labelled at its own level) and the guide and compilation rules from your organization's security classification guide, signed in the classification@1 section. Phase 74.3 documents how. Source: 70.1-CONTEXT.md D-07, D-13, D-16.
title: Classification thresholds, the system-high, markings, code words and guide rules are your organization's to set
